input: The project, the clips to work on (in order, the open clip first), whether a player plays, the most workers, and the work of one clip given by its owner.
output: The clips whose work ended and its result. It runs the threads; it reads and writes nothing, the owner of the job does.
specification: User 2026-10-26: one scheduler for every kind of background job over the clips of a project (filmstrip and wave now; transcripts, scenes and image vectors later), instead of a mirrored copy in each worker. The clip open in a preview goes first: beside the others (work of the processor) or alone (work of the medium). While a player plays only that clip runs, alone; the others are cancelled and queued again. Another project ends every worker and forgets what was done.
